C1.worst_defect: The hero till screenshot contradicts itself on phone: the cart reads "Cart (4) · €59.59" while the customer line says "Guest · 3 items", and the quantity column header is cut to "Q...". A shop owner checking that the numbers add up notices it.

C2.worst_defect: The docs payment screenshot sells a test product called "Tally Fixture Mug", which makes the till look like a test rig rather than something a real shop uses.

C3.worst_defect: The closing step, "Count the drawer and close the day", is text only: there is no screenshot of the close screen or the Z report, although payment and the cashier sheet both get one. Nothing marks which setup steps are 'hand this to your developer' or says how long setup takes, so I can't tell whether staff can sell tomorrow.

C4.worst_defect: Limitations is one flat list of 17 bullets. Counter limits ("does not open a cash drawer", the card terminal, printing) sit next to developer items ("RXDB_PREMIUM", the "settleRefund mutation", "Postgres only"), so I can't quickly see what my staff can't do at the counter. Connect a till and Troubleshooting also lean on developer words ("localStorage", "SQLite databases", "errorCode", "register_session_already_open").

C5.worst_defect: Below the hero, the home page is a long run of feature cards that all look the same in grey, with no visual anchor, so the eye has nowhere to land when skimming between customers.

C6.worst_defect: On phone the hero till image is shrunk until its table header truncates to "Q..." and the small text is hard to read. Otherwise the pages reflow cleanly, with no overflow and tables stacked into rows.

C7.worst_defect: The OG card crops the till at the bottom, so the "Add charge" row is cut off. Otherwise the technical surface is excellent: Lighthouse 97–98/100/100/100, a working 404, llms.txt, sitemap, JSON-LD and working search.

overall_worst.defect: Limitations is one ungrouped list of 17 bullets that mixes counter limits ("does not open a cash drawer", card terminal, offline reload) with developer items ("RXDB_PREMIUM", "settleRefund mutation", "Postgres only"). A shop owner reading on the phone between customers cannot pick out what their staff will hit at the counter.
overall_worst.fix: Split the page under two headings. "At the counter": no cash drawer, no card terminal link, printing, a reload needs the internet, no private windows, one tab per till, refunds via the Dashboard. "For your developer": Postgres only, RXDB_PREMIUM, settleRefund, device keys and versions. Put the counter list first, in plain words.
